text: Soy tu fan (English: I'm your fan) is a Mexican romantic comedy television series produced by Canana Films, Fox Television Studios, and Once TV México, and is an adaptation of the Argentine series of the same name created by Dolores Fonzi and Constanza Novick. The series is directed by Álvaro Hernández, Mariana Chenillo, and Gerardo Naranjo, produced by Pablo Cruz, Constanza Novick, Gael García Bernal, Diego Luna, Geminiano Pineda, Jorge Mondragón, Diego Martínez Ulanosky, and Ana Claudia Talancón, and written by Constanza Novick. It premiered on Wednesday, April 28, 2010, in Mexico on Once TV México and in the United States on mun2 on October 17, 2010. Season 2 began airing on October 19, 2011, on Once TV in Mexico. Charly (played by Ana Claudia Talancón) and Nicolas meet in a coffee shop in Mexico City after Charly's breakup with Julián, the frontman of an upcoming band. Nicolas shows interest in Charly and tells her to inform her therapist, with whom she has an appointment later, that she has just met the love of her life. Charly appreciates the attention but feels harassed by him, until after Nicolas makes endless attempts to get her to go out with him, he gives up and starts dating a struggling actress. The lack of attention causes Charly to reconsider and re-engage in a relationship with Nicolas. Rocío and Fernanda, Charly's best friends, witness her struggle to make the relationship work while still trying to move on from Julián and endure his obnoxious new girlfriend, Vanesa.
